rationale: Both fields store the unique ClinicalTrials.gov National Clinical Trial (NCT) accession identifier.
Both fields store identical GEO sample accession identifiers (GSM numbers) referring to the biological sample.
Both fields record the specific sequencing machine model used to generate the dataset.
Both fields describe the high-level experimental sequencing protocol or assay applied to the library.
Both fields represent the medical disease or health condition being studied or treated by a therapeutic intervention.
